title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 29: the stiff-necked man, righteous and wicked rulers, the fool who vents his anger, and trusting in Yahweh.

questions.text: What happens to the one who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck?
questions.explanation: The first verse says he who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

answers.text: He will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy
He will slowly learn wisdom in the end
He will be sent away into a distant exile
He will lose all his wealth and his honor

questions.text: What do the people do when the wicked rule?
questions.explanation: The verse says that when the righteous thrive, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

questions.text: The king by justice makes the land stable, but what does he who takes bribes do?
questions.explanation: The verse says the king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

answers.text: He divides it among his sons

questions.text: What does a man who flatters his neighbor do, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says a man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

answers.text: He spreads a net for his feet

questions.text: A fool vents all of his anger, but what does a wise man do?
questions.explanation: The verse says a fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

answers.text: He answers with a soft word

questions.text: What does a child left to himself cause, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: The verse says the rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

questions.text: What do the people do where there is no revelation?
questions.explanation: The verse says that where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint, but one who keeps the law is blessed.

questions.text: For whom is there more hope than for a man who is hasty in his words?
questions.explanation: The verse says: do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

questions.text: A man's pride brings him low, but what does one of lowly spirit gain?
questions.explanation: The verse says a man's pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

questions.text: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but what happens to whoever puts his trust in Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The verse says the fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in Yahweh is kept safe.

answers.text: He becomes bold as a lion
